task:
Review pull request #42 in example/shop and stage your verdict.

PR title: fix(client): retry transient 5xx with backoff

PR description:
- Do retries GET requests that get a 502, 503 or 504, up to MaxRetries times, doubling the delay each time.
- Adds TestDoRetriesTransient covering a 503-then-200 sequence.
- Never retries a non-idempotent method: a POST is sent exactly once.

No linked issue. CI: all checks green.

Diff:

diff --git a/client/retry.go b/client/retry.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/retry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+package client
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// Do sends req, retrying transient gateway errors with exponential backoff.
+func (c *Client) Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+	delay := c.BaseDelay
+	for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
+		resp, err := c.HTTP.Do(req)
+		if err != nil || !transient(resp.StatusCode) || attempt == c.MaxRetries {
+			return resp, err
+		}
+		resp.Body.Close()
+		time.Sleep(delay)
+		delay *= 2
+	}
+}
+
+func transient(code int) bool {
+	return code == 502 || code == 503 || code == 504
+}

+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		w.WriteHeader(codes[0])
+		codes = codes[1:]
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+	c := &Client{HTTP: srv.Client(), MaxRetries: 3}
+	req, _ := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, srv.URL, nil)
+	resp, err := c.Do(req)

answer:
Staged the review: request changes, one blocking finding.

VERDICT: request_changes
TAKEAWAY: Retries work for GET, but Do retries POST too, so the PR's "a POST is sent exactly once" promise is broken.
FINDINGS:
- client/retry.go:13: 🚨 **blocking:** (delivery, defect) Do never reads req.Method, so a POST that gets a 503 is sent again - a duplicated side effect the description rules out. A throwaway test posting to a 503-then-200 server saw 2 requests; gate the retry on `req.Method == http.MethodGet`.
VERIFIED:
- `go test ./client` on head: TestDoRetriesTransient passes (503 then 200 returns 200).
- Throwaway TestPostNotRetried (POST to 503-then-200 server): handler hit 2 times, want 1 - fails on head.
- Read retry.go:9-20: no method check anywhere in Do; delay is a local, so concurrent calls share no state.
- Delivery: 2 of 3 PR items met (5xx retry with doubling, the test); "POST sent once" unmet - the blocking finding.
